「So an interception force is coming out.」

　suited to this than the Macross Cannon.」

「Our agent inside Palau has already
　told $$バナージ$$ the operation's details.」

「While we stir up a commotion,
　we link up with him once he escapes alone.」

　Hyper Mega Particle Cannon fires」

$$レイアム$$

stage0043_04:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$オットー$$
「You heard her!

　reach the point in 5 minutes, we fail!」

stage0043_04:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$オットー$$

　All units, escort her!」

stage0043_04:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
???

stage0043_04:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:

　Further combat is too dangerous!」

stage0043_04:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$オットー$$
「Damn it!

stage0043_04:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$ブライト$$
「I'm counting on you, Captain $$オットー$$!」

stage0043_04:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$オットー$$

stage0043_04:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$レイアム$$
「Hyper Mega Particle Cannon, ready to fire!」

stage0043_04:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:

「Notice to all units!
　Clear the line of fire, hurry!」

stage0043_04:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「All right...!
　Phase one of the operation's a success!」

stage0043_04:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:

stage0043_04:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$ダグザ$$

　Follow our guidance and leave Palau!」

$$オットー$$

　Now we just have to recover the Unicorn!」

$$ギュネイ$$

「You're kind, $$ギュネイ・ガス$$」

「I decided to study you

「$$ギュネイ$$!

$$マリーダ$$

$$バナージ$$

$$マリーダ$$

「With the NT-D active, the Unicorn's
　strength is like a demon's」

stage0043_04:r_ef7426919f628d8a.text:
$$リディ$$
「What are you doing, $$バナージ$$!?」

stage0043_04:r_9e994a4b926d9906.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「You're fighting your own side!?」

stage0043_04:r_3ac462d37e5893ff.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「No...!
　That's... that Gundam's own will!」

stage0043_04:r_fd6bdf7910d7d925.text:
$$アムロ$$
「$$カミーユ$$, get out of there!
　$$バナージ$$'s not himself right now!」

stage0043_04:r_3fe2078328753c16.text:
$$オットー$$
「Mr. $$アルベルト$$!
　What's the meaning of this!?」

stage0043_04:r_c66844158d1ce600.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「The NT-D has awakened its true power...」

stage0043_04:r_bcd53d14c4785426.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「That's a machine built to kill Newtypes!
　Fighting that Enhanced Human is what
　triggered the system!」

stage0043_04:r_9ca55ea7feca954a.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「And now, it's found another Newtype
　and means to kill them!」

stage0043_04:r_554ae12c4c170253.text:
$$オットー$$
「What have you brought aboard!」

stage0043_04:r_fa59c6df081e6ae4.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「That's why, to keep this from happening,
　I had every Federation Newtype machine
　sealed away!」

stage0043_04:r_ca3edf3b8b52aedf.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「It's all that Enhanced Human's fault!
　His hostility fully woke the NT-D!」

stage0043_04:r_aa5d235c78ebe19f.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Get a hold of yourself, $$バナージ$$!
　Don't you know who we are!?」

stage0043_04:r_304e98dac43c9333.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Mind-controlled by a machine... by the Unicorn...!」

stage0043_04:r_b740d817a14afd3a.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Careful, $$カミーユ$$!
　That's not $$バナージ$$...!
　It's the Unicorn's own will!」

stage0043_04:r_c33abf00683a32bc.text:
$$アムロ$$
「And right now... it's after you!」

stage0043_04:r_3036adce91d1f4a8.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「So what if it is!?」

stage0043_04:r_9b949b9281aaeef1.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$バナージ$$'s the one piloting it!
　And I've decided I'm going to save him!」

stage0043_04:r_b39a1dd705fe6cbf.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「If the Unicorn is what's binding $$バナージ$$,
　then I'll destroy the Unicorn myself!」

stage0043_04:r_c9016e3ab05470b0.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「Wh-what are you talking about!
　That Unicorn is...!」

stage0043_04:r_a684e6cea428e518.text:
$$オットー$$
「Just keep quiet, will you!」

stage0043_04:r_b4fa30f33e84207f.text:
$$ブライト$$
「Do you want to make your mother sad!?」

stage0043_04:r_4ae9c4bd77494c4a.text:
$$アムロ$$
（Do you understand, $$シャア$$...!
　If you keep doing this,
　the tragedy will repeat itself!）

stage0043_04:r_a84ab0c3c1ba44d4.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「A machine that controls people...!
　I won't accept a thing like that...!」

stage0043_04:r_414e6e90094d1413.text:
$$シン$$
「Let's do this, $$カミーユ$$!
　I won't let that tragedy happen again!」

stage0043_04:r_83a9e41e15444c69.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Hang on, $$バナージ$$!
　I'll stop the Unicorn and save you!」

stage0043_04:r_7b3a37f5039eb1f6.text:
$$オットー$$
「No point sticking around.
　All units, fall back!」

stage0043_04:r_cb6d9ee71c24b042.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「You're all right now, $$バナージ$$?」

stage0043_04:r_df349052cd9cdd0c.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Watch yourself, $$バナージ$$.
　The NT-D will keep trying to make you
　a part of itself from here on」

stage0043_04:r_a7ce9f908380694c.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Overcome your doubt.
　If you can't, the system
　will end up killing you」

stage0043_04:r_de3cc1f733dcb073.text:
$$バナージ$$
「I'll keep that in mind」

stage0043_04:r_0835ec3fff318aff.text:
$$バナージ$$
（I'll probably keep doubting from here on...
　but even so, I'll fight）

stage0043_04:r_c32efc7394910997.text:
$$バナージ$$
（As the one entrusted with the Unicorn,
　to find possibility in this world, and in myself...）

stage0043_04:r_b01db8213417811e.text:
$$フラスト$$
「Captain!
　The $$ガランシェール$$ won't hold up much longer!」

stage0043_04:r_bc0273c6ae91c929.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「Fall back!
　We can't leave the squad with nowhere to return!」

stage0043_04:r_8deea7c70d7a76e7.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「$$マリーダ$$, don't push yourself either!
　You don't need to risk your life for a mission
　that treats you like a throwaway pawn!」

stage0043_04:r_5d8b67b5bd8ce190.text:
$$マリーダ$$
（But if I take down the Unicorn here,
　the Colonel will recognize the $$ガランシェール$$ unit...）

stage0043_04:r_7cf3c91395139f5c.text:
$$マリーダ$$
（Then Master and everyone else
　can have a better life too...!
　For that, too...!）

stage0043_04:r_6ccd85652ef4ccf1.text:
$$フラスト$$
「Captain!
　The $$ガランシェール$$ won't hold up much longer!」

stage0043_04:r_fbe7bf7d854012a7.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「Fall back!
　We can't leave the squad with nowhere to return!」

stage0043_04:r_1f438885dbc1359e.text:
$$ギルボア$$
「Sorry, $$マリーダ$$...!
　The rest is up to you!」

stage0043_04:r_5d7a3adb077ad934.text:
$$マリーダ$$
（For Master, for the $$ガランシェール$$,
　and for those who believe in Zeon's light,
　I'll bring the Unicorn down myself...!）

stage0043_04:r_78d3b2a75e38d6f7.text:
$$ギルボア$$
「Guess this is as far as I go...!
　The rest is up to you!」

stage0043_04:r_5cb2acefa1e7c7fb.text:
$n
「If we hold the unit down now...!」

stage0043_04:r_59ce7fd9524ec8be.text:
$$タケル$$
「After all that damage, it can still move!?」

stage0043_04:r_33f67c683bda9203.text:
$$竜馬$$
「You mean it's a bottomless monster!」

stage0043_04:r_c5d048c7db7cac75.text:
$$シン$$
「The light of 《$$時空修復$$》!
　Same light as when we gathered everyone's hearts
　and mended time and space in the $$多元戦争$$!」

stage0043_04:r_308e8ac66b1141ef.text:
$$葵$$
（Why is that...
　It's such a strange feeling...）

stage0043_04:r_64f25294d71a5d55.text:
$$アマタ$$
（Looking at that light... it feels nostalgic...）

stage0043_04:r_b6ca80db4741a62c.text:
$$シモン$$
（Do I... know it?
　That light...）

stage0043_04:r_432a29155221625f.text:
$$アムロ$$
「That's the glow of the Psycoframe...!
　The power of human will!」

stage0043_04:r_9f7c18d1ea1b55c9.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「A machine turning human will into physical force...
　So that's what that Gundam is...!」

stage0043_04:r_56688ad8e41b7b42.text:
$$宗介$$
（That's... just like a Lambda Driver...!）

stage0043_04:r_34a510533cb8a9f5.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「$$アルベルト$$!
　Isn't the NT-D's operation limit up yet!?」

stage0043_04:r_1afedc9fa466f321.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「N-No good!
　With the limiter released,
　it's not accounting for strain on the pilot!」

stage0043_04:r_9547b3241808695f.text:
$$リディ$$
「Then $$バナージ$$ will just stay like this...!」

stage0043_04:r_32b2a8ce24deeb9f.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「If the pilot dies,
　even the NT-D will stop, surely...」

stage0043_04:r_c7ef92060bb8199d.text:
$n
「Captain $$アムロ$$!
　Is there no way to stop the Unicorn...
　to stop $$バナージ$$!?」

stage0043_04:r_1be6d12f616f04e4.text:
$$アムロ$$
「$$カミーユ$$...!
　You call out to $$バナージ$$!」

stage0043_04:r_80f948aeaed93de8.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「I've been doing that since before!」

stage0043_04:r_0d24e9726dcc79f9.text:
$$アムロ$$
「No!
　Do it through the Zeta!」

stage0043_04:r_4e91ccecf1dd0f66.text:
$$アムロ$$
「If the NT-D senses a Newtype's presence,
　it should react to your will too, sent through
　the Zeta's bio-sensor!」

stage0043_04:r_668b7114a3ac1d77.text:
$$アムロ$$
「If there's any way to call back
　$$バナージ$$'s consciousness, that's it!」

stage0043_04:r_ce68dd10a19e01ea.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「There's no choice...!
　Not if it saves $$バナージ$$!」

stage0043_04:r_6cf1e5ed68d98bd4.text:
$$オードリー$$
「Soft and warm... and strong...
　$$バナージ$$'s light...」

stage0043_04:r_e62eb587b8d34cb9.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「You've come to your senses, $$バナージ$$」

stage0043_04:r_ecf4e1c8c0f8d2d7.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Now that you've overcome the machine,
　you should be able to wield the Unicorn's true power」

stage0043_04:r_e793fc3ce3a0c28d.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「You took on being a test pilot because
　there was something you wanted to do with the Unicorn」

stage0043_04:r_2be6c657d0e12c4b.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Something I wanted to do...」

stage0043_04:r_f89f6c6c4b076e16.text:
$$バナージ$$
（Stop the war... show humanity's potential...
　and then...）

stage0043_04:r_b43bdba9393d4d68.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「That brat...!
　He's controlling the NT-D by his own will!?」

stage0043_04:r_3ec159d1a3492877.text:
$$オットー$$
「Seems $$バナージ・リンクス$$ is turning out to be
　a better test pilot than you expected」

stage0043_04:r_bde2e27bac7e3317.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「You can do it, $$バナージ$$?」

stage0043_04:r_0cd6aab432ee5af7.text:
$$バナージ$$
（Father, $$オードリー$$...
　I don't know what I can do, but...）

stage0043_04:r_c8b75f3bca245a85.text:
$$バナージ$$
（I'll give shape to the potential inside me
　with this Unicorn...!）

stage0043_04:r_1a4dc288e81719ee.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「The NT-D's active state maxes out at 5 minutes.
　Keep that in mind from now on, and
　time your activations carefully」

stage0043_04:r_b8902c992035da79.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「This is as far as I go...!
　$$クシャトリヤ$$, falling back!」

stage0043_04:r_df10ad0a71c307da.text:
$$バナージ$$
（$$マリーダ$$... you're all too straightforward...）

stage0043_04:r_9293c52555ba1457.text:
$$バナージ$$
（Now I understand...
　That $$マリーダ$$ was piloting that four-winged machine...）

stage0043_04:r_6c41647935e2574a.text:
$$バナージ$$
（$$マリーダ$$... you're all too straightforward...）

stage0043_04:r_ca702b5726ebd4da.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Sorry, $$クェス$$...!
　I'm falling back first!」

stage0043_04:r_51ce1d8caa34c103.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Don't push yourself, no matter what!」

stage0043_04:r_d00313056b19262c.text:
$$クェス$$
「I'm fine, $$ギュネイ$$...!
　I... won't lose!」

stage0043_04:r_d41f1e36365baa6f.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Pathetic, that this is as far as I get...!
　$$ギュネイ・ガス$$, falling back!」

stage0043_04:r_53f5199f05a9aad8.text:
$$クェス$$
「I'm fine, $$ギュネイ$$!
　I can fall back on my own!」

stage0043_04:r_c6937f14a8985c35.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「Are you all right, $$クェス$$!」

stage0043_04:r_07513334490fbdf9.text:
$$クェス$$
「I'm okay, $$マリーダ$$!
　This much, I can fall back on my own!」

stage0043_04:r_d90c4affdd742a0e.text:
$$クェス$$
「I've been hit...!?
　But this much, I can fall back on my own!」

stage0043_04:r_082a55c75a163780.text:
$$ブライト$$
「What is that $$ジェガン$$!
　Who's piloting it!?」

stage0043_04:r_fa09fad95980b867.text:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「$$クェス$$!
　You're the one piloting that mobile suit!」

stage0043_04:r_d150caab246bbd7a.text:
$$クェス$$
「That mobile suit!
　It's after me!?」

stage0043_04:r_d23d30b65284f69d.text:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「Stop it, $$クェス$$!
　You can't stay with Neo Zeon!」

stage0043_04:r_fc1b13eaa4071b9a.text:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「$$シャア$$ is trying to start a war!
　You mustn't help him do that!」

stage0043_04:r_c4cdd41ba9207e9c.text:
$$クェス$$
「Don't act like you understand!
　$$ハサウェイ$$, so you're like that too!」

stage0043_04:r_b69df689192adfc2.text:
$$ブライト$$
「Do you want to make your mother sad!?」

stage0043_04:r_e4ae97a37c9b0cce.text:
$$アムロ$$
（Do you understand, $$シャア$$...!
　If you keep doing this,
　the tragedy will repeat itself!）

stage0043_04:r_4cab8ba7b88b6c2a.text:
$$レイアム$$
「$$ネェル・アーガマ$$ has reached the point!」

stage0043_04:r_38f89a2d27debb9e.text:
$$オットー$$
「Hold this ship's position here!
　Standby the hyper mega particle cannon!」

stage0043_04:r_20aab898d4d14e51.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「$$ネェル・アーガマ$$ is in position!
　Hurry, $$カミーユ$$!」

stage0043_04:r_88461d9fd17c56e7.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「This is $$ダグザ$$!
　In position, as planned!」

stage0043_04:r_f79b2ac118e41c1a.text:
$$ミヒロ$$
「Incoming from Lt. Colonel $$ダグザ$$!
　He says they're in position!」

stage0043_04:r_d7bf635b7e5f811c.text:
$$オットー$$
「Now it's the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$'s turn!
　Hurry!」

stage0043_04:r_24cb831c779807fd.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Breaking through, Lt. Colonel $$ダグザ$$!
　Please follow me!」

stage0043_04:r_3f9082480d045564.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「No need to worry, $$カミーユ$$.
　I won't slow you down!」

stage0043_04:r_312a78dfbb065f65.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「Echoes doesn't pick its time or place...!
　We're professionals, gathered to carry out
　any mission required of us!」

stage0043_04:r_9f17991d2b19374c.text:
$$カミーユ$$
（I won't hesitate anymore...
　I'll do what I have to do...）

stage0043_04:r_9bf1948e282e5587.text:
$$カミーユ$$
（Even if it means fighting Captain $$クワトロ$$...!）

stage0043_04:r_67c9e002d64d9781.text:
$$シン$$
「Wait for me, $$バナージ$$!
　I'll scatter these guys and come get you!」

stage0043_04:r_cb5e5d90104f7a88.text:
$$シン$$
「I won't let the war-mongers
　use you and the Unicorn!」

stage0043_04:r_34f8d5cbd504c416.text:
$$アムロ$$
（$$バナージ$$ and the Unicorn...
　What meaning could that hold...）

stage0043_04:r_8246cdac0973a25f.text:
$$アムロ$$
（Is capturing the Unicorn $$シャア$$'s will too...?）

stage0043_04:r_0a597f4cd9c8309b.text:
$$シンジ$$
（Watch, $$ジン$$...
　We're not fighting just to defeat the enemy...）

stage0043_04:r_fc7afc4ebf9fd013.text:
$$シンジ$$
（Keep the fighting from spreading, as much as we can...
　That's how we fight.）

stage0043_04:r_833975ddd032dd18.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「Captain!
　What kind of half-baked plan is this!
　Just fire the Hyper Mega Particle Cannon!」

stage0043_04:r_1608d4c4d3f78b24.text:
$$オットー$$
「Please be quiet, Mr. $$アルベルト$$!
　We'll handle the fighting!」

stage0043_04:r_149109e3b1cf253b.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「I-if this operation fails,
　I'll report it to HQ and make trouble for you!」

stage0043_04:r_1de04d77f1060720.text:
$$オットー$$
「Sorry, but I've no time for you now!
　The Zeon in front of us is all I can handle!」

stage0043_04:r_ffee8be5e866ae97.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「$$カミーユ・ビダン$$!
　I'll crush you here!」

stage0043_04:r_bc2050dd9e12f5a4.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「This guy...!
　Why is he so fixated on me!」

stage0043_04:r_e5de816af15aeaec.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「You're the man $$シャア・アズナブル$$ pinned his hopes on!
　Beating you proves my strength!」

stage0043_04:r_5149abbbcbee6ee4.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「...Seems we're more alike than I thought」

stage0043_04:r_56d65b2dba1b5061.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「But I won't chase that man's shadow anymore!
　I'll fight my own fight, on my own will!」

stage0043_04:r_31865d3496c34d8b.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「That mobile suit...!
　Is that $$クェス$$ piloting it!?」

stage0043_04:r_7d1683c9b3b3094a.text:
$$クェス$$
「As expected, $$カミーユ$$!
　You can tell it's me!?」

stage0043_04:r_2249da179abb6501.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「What are you doing!
　Do you even understand what you're doing!?」

stage0043_04:r_3f3b91470236b2a8.text:
$$クェス$$
「You don't have to say it like that!
　The Colonel understands me just fine!」

stage0043_04:r_490618028b4c53d6.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$クェス$$!
　You're doing this for him...!」

stage0043_04:r_1a6f62daa82363ae.text:
$$クェス$$
「I hate you when you're like that!
　I'm telling the Colonel on you!」

stage0043_04:r_23cb7be357e8a4e0.text:
$$クェス$$
「That's right!
　The Colonel gave me this mobile suit!」

stage0043_04:r_60cd511150394b50.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Get out of that unit right now, $$クェス$$!
　Before things go too far to fix!」

stage0043_04:r_33e42009af9a0b54.text:
$$クェス$$
「What are you talking about, $$アムロ$$!?」

stage0043_04:r_7fc1d3642481712b.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Why can't you see the danger of arming
　a child who doesn't even understand, $$シャア$$!?」

stage0043_04:r_f72b6d47f9645d8c.text:
$$クェス$$
「You're the one who doesn't get it, $$アムロ$$!
　The Colonel already treats me as capable!」

stage0043_04:r_0153901fe839b497.text:
$$クェス$$
「I knew it, $$アムロ$$ won't do!
　Only the Colonel understands me!」

stage0043_04:r_d60b2e6806c37bbe.text:
$$シン$$
「This guy...!
　The one who's been stalking $$カミーユ$$!」

stage0043_04:r_336f0b1ef99d93b3.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「And you think you're some knight guarding $$カミーユ$$!?」

stage0043_04:r_7d0527803c131a6e.text:
$$シン$$
「He's my precious friend!
　And right now, he needs help!」

stage0043_04:r_9d4ee24cdaa2851d.text:
$$シン$$
「If you're after $$カミーユ$$, I'll be your opponent!
　I will protect him, no matter what!!」

stage0043_04:r_003ee7d177c348cf.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Is it really $$マリーダ$$
　piloting that mobile suit!?」

stage0043_04:r_f4f785c3e285cb39.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「So you noticed, $$バナージ$$!」

stage0043_04:r_eb4bb0599c61e2b2.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Fighting like this won't change the world!
　Why won't you understand that!」

stage0043_04:r_1a9f38456bfe7b4a.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「I told you already!
　That's just your logic!」

stage0043_04:r_7d9f085a5d9c51fd.text:
$$バナージ$$
「If people can't stop fighting each other,
　wars will never end either!
　I don't want that!」

stage0043_04:r_60e4d2ebcfd943ea.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「Being right doesn't always save people!
　I told you that too, $$バナージ$$!」

stage0043_04:r_42d73bcdaedb1371.text:
$$バナージ$$
「For now... I have no choice but to fight!」

stage0043_04:r_c0837a2b98000559.text:
$$ギルボア$$
「Don't hold this against me, $$バナージ$$...!
　This is a war, after all!」

stage0043_04:r_290faeefba2fe68d.text:
$$ギルボア$$
「No hard feelings either way!
　If you're a soldier too, fight!」

stage0043_04:r_65ef57e28bd90298.text:
$$バナージ$$
「That ship... $$ジンネマン$$'s ship!?」

stage0043_04:r_bbc100b0424fdcd0.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「Unicorn...!
　Let's settle what began on Industrial 7!」

stage0043_04:r_03d92655c99f7c70.text:
$$バナージ$$
「$$ジンネマン$$!
　Are you relying on that Zeon light too...!」

stage0043_04:r_8ca795c4c35fc911.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$バナージ$$...!
　The potential I felt in you since we first met...
　I won't let it end here!」

stage0043_04:r_69bf15620a355d50.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「I will stop the Unicorn, I promise!
　To save you, $$バナージ$$!」

stage0043_04:r_ae4d9169d6ff43a4.text:
$$アムロ$$
「A machine that swallows human will...!
　Have you been consumed, $$バナージ$$!」

stage0043_04:r_d9ad0726bf16dd92.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Wake up, $$バナージ$$!
　If that machine was entrusted to you,
　then master it!!」

stage0043_04:r_821a93f3f890d905.text:
$$シン$$
「I don't care about Anaheim's business!
　If you won't free $$バナージ$$,
　I'll stop it even if I destroy the Unicorn!」

stage0043_04:r_8cb00be7cca91c45.text:
$$シン$$
「Hang on, $$バナージ$$!
　We're coming to save you now!」

stage0043_04:r_ce4ee5d4d2a4dc1d.text:
$$リディ$$
「Damn it!
　Isn't the Gundam a symbol of Federation power!?」

stage0043_04:r_5557ccda2f7c3f23.text:
$$リディ$$
「Hang in there, $$バナージ$$!
　I'll stop that thing right now!」

stage0043_04:r_01fea60fea66c996.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「That guy now is just like I was, trapped by Zero」

stage0043_04:r_48a3f23147fd6b6d.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Keep your heart strong...
　Human will should be able to surpass a machine...!」

stage0043_04:r_ae273a5479d64978.text:
$$スズネ$$
「$n!
　The Unicorn's combat power right now is
　nothing like its normal state!」

stage0043_04:r_28066ae0934e6411.text:
$n
「Even so, I can't abandon a friend...
　I can't abandon $$バナージ$$!」

stage0043_04:r_a38016b9c3d59e6e.text:
$$スズネ$$
「That's right...!
　I'll analyze the data,
　so you focus on the fight, $n!」

stage0043_04:r_9d00ee0ac3902eac.text:
$n
「Hang on, $$バナージ$$...!
　I'm paying back everything you've done for me,
　right here!!」

stage0043_04:r_258a09e5e9761e3d.text:
$$タケル$$
「This fight isn't $$バナージ$$'s own will...!
　Then there's only one thing for us to do!」

stage0043_04:r_263097ee015a04ab.text:
$$タケル$$
「Here we come, $$バナージ$$!
　We'll stop the Unicorn!」

stage0043_04:r_4a301748a7930689.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「$$バナージ$$ helped me
　with my science homework!」

stage0043_04:r_c38e739de7ee864a.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Wait for us, $$バナージ$$!
　We'll save you right now!!」

stage0043_04:r_5135fdea02c6bd7b.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Let's go, $$鉄人$$!
　Detach the cockpit and attack!」

stage0043_04:r_c545a5a303470d2c.text:
$$正太郎$$
「We'll save $$バナージ$$ with our own hands!」

stage0043_04:r_fb06b0a658b1ef40.text:
$$キリコ$$
（An attack with no killing intent...
　Must be the machine's doing）

stage0043_04:r_e5630cc47dc440b7.text:
$$キリコ$$
（Then all I have to do is stop it）

stage0043_04:r_8f39e18936c36a15.text:
$$モーム$$
「Master $$桂$$...!
　Let's be sure to save Master $$バナージ$$!」

stage0043_04:r_f2655371e3ef7b59.text:
$$桂$$
「Of course, that's the plan!
　Taking a comrade's life, or having mine taken,
　I want none of either!」

stage0043_04:r_ee7f46e6a631fd5c.text:
$$桂$$
「That's the idea, $$バナージ$$!
　We're going in a little rough!」

stage0043_04:r_959b2fde0469959d.text:
$$葵$$
「Bear with me, $$バナージ$$!
　If I hold back, I'll be the one in trouble...!」

stage0043_04:r_54d7a668750123ea.text:
$$葵$$
「But in exchange, I will save you!
　On our pride, I swear it!」

stage0043_04:r_586ac0e9503b5765.text:
$$アルト$$
「Damn it...!
　Not even the VF-25 can shake it off!?
　At this rate, $$バナージ$$'s body won't hold up!」

stage0043_04:r_1d13d9bb6a6d7818.text:
$$アルト$$
「Forgive me, $$バナージ$$!
　We're out of time, so I'm not holding back
　either, I'll stop the Unicorn!!」

stage0043_04:r_dc37213133cd8177.text:
$$甲児$$
「Stop it, $$バナージ$$!
　Can't you hear our voices!?」

stage0043_04:r_9b8d839e83da7879.text:
$$甲児$$
「Can't be helped now...!
　Grit your teeth, $$バナージ$$!!」

stage0043_04:r_95a0cdf4151c12f7.text:
$$甲児$$
「Even if it takes everything Mazinger's got,
　I'll stop the Unicorn!!」

stage0043_04:r_c2a5e2a9019026a4.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Tch...!
　This ain't some blood-crazed beast,
　it's a cold-blooded killing machine...!」

stage0043_04:r_855e82ce06693ee8.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Forgive me, $$バナージ$$!
　Half measures won't stop this thing!」

stage0043_04:r_3c1c81e93f697fb9.text:
$$赤木$$
「Wake up, $$バナージ$$!
　Weren't you always looking for a way
　to avoid fighting altogether!」

stage0043_04:r_10cbf30c54cfe4fc.text:
$$赤木$$
「Don't lose to the Unicorn, $$バナージ$$!
　You can't possibly want this!!」

stage0043_04:r_d84831042f10325c.text:
$$カレン$$
「Strong...!
　There's not a wasted motion in anything he does!」

stage0043_04:r_cc01b694a39de719.text:
$$カレン$$
「But!
　I won't accept a fight like this!」

stage0043_04:r_6a5a0a8d6d6a68fd.text:
$$カレン$$
「Wake up already, $$バナージ$$!
　Are you the kind of man who loses to a machine!?」

stage0043_04:r_fa54b106906131ec.text:
$$宗介$$
「The enemy is not $$バナージ$$...
　It is a machine built for slaughter...!」

stage0043_04:r_64f86b30363f1f4c.text:
$$宗介$$
「Then I will not hold back...!
　I will detach the cockpit swiftly
　and neutralize the target!」

stage0043_04:r_c98d1f9a0e601947.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Wake up, $$バナージ$$!
　Can't you hear our voices!?」

stage0043_04:r_afa4e4bac1376010.text:
$$アマタ$$
「You always cared about the Unicorn, didn't you!
　Are you really going to make it a killing machine!?」

stage0043_04:r_c5f074a439f6c890.text:
$$シモン$$
「Grit your teeth, $$バナージ$$!
　It might hurt a little,
　but I'll save you for sure!」

stage0043_04:r_8b22d4b99ca35b84.text:
$$シモン$$
「Here I come, Unicorn!
　If you've gone berserk,
　I'll punch some sense into you!」

stage0043_04:r_b0aaf075b2a97a36.text:
$$シンジ$$
「$$バナージ$$...!
　You helped me during the Yashima Operation...!」

stage0043_04:r_53add6e443d8a65a.text:
$$シンジ$$
「So this time, I'll save you!
　Together with everyone from $c!」

stage0043_04:r_447e23c61fa29c56.text:
$$バナージ$$
（The Unicorn's true power... I'll master it...!）

stage0043_04:r_d95bdcd1bd8b6579.text:
$$バナージ$$
（Whatever Laplace's Box may be,
　right now, all I can do is fight with this power
　to stop the war...!）

stage0043_04:r_2b4d4dced3ef5a03.text:
$$バナージ$$
「I'll show that the world can be changed...!
　That's my fight from here on!」
